leadText:
Jin Kusude (Japanese: 楠出 尽 Kusude Jin, unknown name and date of birth) is an undercover manga author for the Japanese Shonen manga series Pokémon RéBURST with Mitsuhisa Tamura.

After the serialization ended, he went to write the Fierce Battle! Ganbarider!! manga for Kamen Rider Gaim from 2014-2016 when the serialization ended for the retooling of the Gambarizing arcade game. He has no public performance since.
 
 
it:Jin Kusude
